requirements.title: Technical Sheet and Colour Reference Documentation

patches.decision_note: Artwork-file preparation and Technical Sheet documentation can change and fail independently; message 44 reports correctly resized files while the Technical Sheet retains obsolete measurements.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Orne,
This is beautiful — we love it. Thank you!
I think we're ready to move to final artwork.
Would it be possible to add the small borders around each design?
Zebra — Black border
Weave — Mustard border
If you're happy with that, we can then move into the block print stage.
Are you comfortable with the Pantone colours we've selected?

execution.observed_behavior: After reviewing the updated basket-weave artwork, the client approves the design direction as beautiful and ready to move into final artwork.

patches.decision_note: The approval follows delivery of updated zebra and weave artwork and explicitly addresses both designs; the equivalent zebra verification is already present.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports final delivery of four production-ready pareo files and a Zebra Savanna repeat tile.

patches.decision_note: The source specifically identifies the delivered bonus tile as Zebra Savanna; the observation should preserve that potentially material version name.

The client selected the smaller Zebra Noir version, but the final-delivery message names a Zebra Savanna tile. Because the tile is described as a bonus and the production pareo version is not enumerated, the evidence cannot establish whether this is a delivery conflict or only a bonus-tile naming difference.

The current block-colour Events interpret 7 cm and 17 cm inconsistently as border options or slim/full measurements. Message 34 alone does not resolve their exact meaning, so the raw proposal in message 33 must be reviewed before retaining those value updates.
